# Distributed SLAM: Core layer, ORB-SLAM3

[ORBSLAM3](https://github.com/JussiKalliola/DSLAM_core) | [orbslam3 ros2](https://github.com/JussiKalliola/DSLAM_ros2) | [orbslam3 interfaces](https://github.com/JussiKalliola/nano-slam-ros2) | [Dockerhub](https://hub.docker.com/repository/docker/jussikalliola/nano-ros2-orbslam3/general)


This repository if the official implementation of the core layer in [Distributed SLAM]() work. For detailed description of the ORB SLAM3, please visit [the original repository]().
